description: Header file defining the RefreshRateOverlay class and related classes for managing overlay display of refresh rate information in Android's SurfaceFlinger component.

classes.name: SurfaceControlHolder
classes.description: Helper class to manage the lifetime of SurfaceControl objects on a separate thread.

classes.name: RefreshRateOverlay
classes.description: Class responsible for overlaying refresh rate information on the display, including drawing digits and managing buffers.

classes.name: SevenSegmentDrawer
classes.description: Nested class for drawing seven-segment style digits representing refresh rates.

methods.name: SurfaceControlHolder::~SurfaceControlHolder
methods.description: Destructor for SurfaceControlHolder, likely handles cleanup on a helper thread.

methods.name: RefreshRateOverlay::RefreshRateOverlay
methods.description: Constructor initializing overlay with FPS range and feature flags.

methods.name: RefreshRateOverlay::setLayerStack
methods.description: Sets the layer stack for the overlay.

methods.name: RefreshRateOverlay::setViewport
methods.description: Sets the viewport size for the overlay.

methods.name: RefreshRateOverlay::changeRefreshRate
methods.description: Updates the overlay with new display and render FPS values.

methods.name: RefreshRateOverlay::animate
methods.description: Animates the overlay, possibly for smooth updates.

methods.name: RefreshRateOverlay::isSetByHwc
methods.description: Checks if the overlay is set by hardware composer.

methods.name: SevenSegmentDrawer::draw
methods.description: Draws the seven-segment digits for given FPS values.

methods.name: SevenSegmentDrawer::drawSegment
methods.description: Draws individual segments of the digit.

methods.name: RefreshRateOverlay::getOrCreateBuffers
methods.description: Retrieves or creates buffers for drawing.
